chartPattern.explanation: A left shoulder formed around $88.29 (mid-May), followed by a higher head at $89.95 (early June). Price is now forming a right shoulder, having bounced from ~$83.96, with the current price at $85.83. The neckline connects the troughs at ~$81.46 and ~$83.96.
chartPattern.signal: A confirmed Head and Shoulders pattern could signal a bearish reversal, indicating a potential downtrend after the breakdown below the neckline.

fundamentals.name: Interactive Brokers Group, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Interactive Brokers Group, Inc. operates as an automated electronic broker in the United States and internationally. The company engages in the execution, clearance, and settlement of trades in stocks, options, futures, foreign exchange instruments, bonds, precious metals, and cryptocurrencies; and the company provides custody, prime brokerage, securities, and margin lending services. It also offers custody and service accounts for hedge and mutual funds, ETFs, registered investment advisors, proprietary trading groups, introducing brokers, and individual investors. In addition, the company provides trading platforms, including IBKR Trader Workstation, IBKR Desktop, IBKR Mobile, and IBKR Client Portal platform, as well as IBKR GlobalTrader mobile application, and IBKR APIs, builds custom trading applications and automates any part of the trading process. Further, it offers IBKR Pro, IBKR Lite, IBKR Universal Account, insured bank deposit sweep program, investors' marketplace, mutual fund marketplace, bond marketplace, forecast and event contracts, fractional trading, no transaction fee program for exchange-traded funds, overnight trading hours, and karta visa infinite charge card. It serves institutional and individual customers through electronic exchanges and market centers. Interactive Brokers Group, Inc. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut.

judgment.summary: A high-growth, highly profitable brokerage with a strong balance sheet and a premium valuation.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter EPS was $0.60, in line with estimates; next earnings date is 2026-07-14.
positives: Revenue growth 16.8% YoY and earnings growth 22.9% YoY indicate strong top and bottom-line expansion.
Profit margin of 16.1% and operating margin of 76.8% demonstrate exceptional profitability.
Return on equity at 23.6% shows efficient use of shareholder capital.
Substantial total cash of $124.59B provides significant liquidity.
The company is recognized as one of the best online brokerages for 2026.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 37.50 and Forward P/E of 30.48 suggest a high valuation.
PEG ratio of 2.28 indicates that growth may not fully justify the current P/E.
Debt/Equity ratio of 152.19 is high, although offset by strong cash reserves.
Mean analyst target of $87.00 is slightly below the current spot price.

news.paragraph: Interactive Brokers (IBKR) launched an AI trading platform that has seen strong returns, according to recent reports. The company is also highlighted as a potentially undervalued stock compared to competitors like Schwab, and is recognized as one of the best online brokerages for 2026. Furthermore, the recent demise of the Pattern Day Trader (PDT) rule is expected to benefit IBKR, alongside other major brokers. Baron Financials Fund also holds IBKR for its long-term growth potential.
